industrĭōsus , a, um, adj. industria,
I.very active, diligent, or industrious (postAug.), Cassiod. Var. 8, 33; Sen. Prov. 2 dub.; Val. Max. 3, 4, 2 dub.—Hence, adv.: industrĭōsē , very industriously, Cassiod. Var. 5, 1; Suet. Vit. Juv.— Comp., Fronto ad M. Caes. 4, 3 med.— Sup., Cato ap. Charis. p. 181 P.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
